AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted KUA Donorojo administrator registry record.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA administrator.

email.description: Verified Google email of the KUA administrator.

displayName.description: Full display name of the KUA administrator.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

role.description: Role of the signed-in Google account.

StaffAccount.title: StaffAccount
StaffAccount.description: Username and hashed password credentials for Admin KUA Donorojo and 8 Modin Desa, managed by Admin KUA.

username.description: Unique lowercase login username (e.g., adminkua, modin.blingoh).

villageId.description: Assigned village slug ID for Modin accounts, empty for Admin.

villageName.description: Display name of the assigned village (e.g., Desa Blingoh).

officerName.description: Full name of the officer or Modin.

whatsappNumber.description: WhatsApp phone number for Smart Reminder.

googleEmail.description: Optional lowercased Google email for cross-device Modin sync.

active.description: Whether this login account is currently active.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA workspace owner.

ReminderSettings.title: ReminderSettings
ReminderSettings.description: Smart Reminder configuration for automatic phone notifications and WhatsApp reminders managed by Admin KUA.

autoPhoneNotifEnabled.description: Enable automatic phone notifications for Modin on wedding days.

whatsappReminderEnabled.description: Enable WhatsApp Smart Reminder workflow in Admin KUA.

remindOneDayBefore.description: Send reminder on H-1 before wedding day.

remindThreeDaysBefore.description: Send reminder on H-3 before wedding day.

reminderTime.description: Preferred daily reminder time in HH:mm WIB format.

whatsappTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp message template with placeholders.

updatedByName.description: Name of Admin KUA who last updated settings.

allowedReaderEmails.description: Bounded list (max 20) of authorized Modin emails for read sync.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the KUA workspace owner.

Village.title: Village
Village.description: One of the 8 official villages in Donorojo with assigned Modin info.

code.description: Normalized village slug code matching document ID.

modinEmail.description: Optional lowercased Google email of the Modin.

createdByUid.description: UID of the Admin KUA who created the village entry.

MarriageSchedule.title: MarriageSchedule
MarriageSchedule.description: Marriage registration and akad nikah schedule managed by Admin KUA Donorojo and monitored in real-time by village Modin.

groomName.description: Full name of the prospective groom.

groomNik.description: Optional NIK of the prospective groom.

brideName.description: Full name of the prospective bride.

brideNik.description: Optional NIK of the prospective bride.

villageId.description: Document ID of the village in /villages/{villageId}.

weddingDate.description: Scheduled akad date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

weddingTime.description: Scheduled akad time in HH:mm 24-hour WIB format.

locationType.description: Balai Nikah KUA or outside KUA.

locationAddress.description: Full venue address for the akad nikah.

validationStatus.description: Final validation status set exclusively by Admin KUA.

documentsComplete.description: Whether required N1-N4 documents are complete.

verificationNote.description: Official verification note from Admin KUA.

verifiedByName.description: Name of Admin KUA officer who performed verification.

allowedModinEmails.description: Denormalized bounded list (max 10) of Modin emails.

createdByUid.description: UID of the Admin KUA who created the record.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of verified KUA Donorojo administrators.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/staff_accounts/{accountId}.description: Username/password credentials for Admin KUA and 8 Modin Desa.

/reminder_settings/{settingId}.description: Smart Reminder settings for phone notifications and WhatsApp.

/villages/{villageId}.description: 8 official villages in Donorojo and their assigned Modin contacts.

/marriage_schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Marriage registrations and akad schedules managed by Admin KUA and monitored read-only by village Modin.
